mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen for three consecutive weeks (-46.3 to -43.0), indicating a self-reinforcing recovery momentum in shopping and recreation activity that should continue over the next four weeks absent a shock.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC improved each of the last three weeks
failure_condition: Mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than or equal to the mean over the last 28 days despite three prior weeks of consecutive improvement.

mechanism_narrative: If TRANSIT mobility improves by more than 3 points week-on-week for two consecutive weeks, it signals relaxation of transit restrictions or rising commuter confidence, which should mechanically feed through to higher retail and recreation footfall within two weeks as people resume in-person shopping trips.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves by more than 3 points week-on-week for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT rose from -46.4 to -41.9 over the snapshot window
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to rise over the next two weeks after TRANSIT meets the threshold improvement condition in two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous improvement in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT indicates a joint resumption of commuting and transit use, which compounds to amplify retail recreation mobility beyond what either series alone would predict, because workers combine commute trips with shopping stops.
candidate_trigger: both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT improve week-on-week simultaneously for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:both WORKPLACES and TRANSIT improved over the last three weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC growth over the next 2 weeks is not greater than the growth predicted by either WORKPLACES or TRANSIT alone when both co-improve.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has remained persistently elevated (11.7-13.3) and shows no clear downward trend, indicating a sustained caution regime in which households continue to limit non-essential outings, which should suppress RETAIL_REC growth over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL stayed between 11.7 and 13.3 over four weeks with no downward trend
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises substantially over the next 28 days even though RESIDENTIAL stays flat or rises further, falsifying the suppression linkage.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not rise over the next 28 days despite the approach of the festival season, indicating seasonal demand is not materializing.
